subject: Polaris Analytics Marketplace renewal: term harmonization & onboarding
messages:
From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: sarah.jenkins@polarisanalytics.com, procurement@polarisanalytics.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-24T09:12:00Z
Subject: Polaris Analytics renewal: aligning terms + staged capacity uplift

Hi Sarah / Polaris procurement team —

Thanks again for the productive call earlier. As discussed, Polaris is up for renewal in Nov and the team is looking to:
- Harmonize the AWS & Azure private offers into a single 12-month term
- Add a staged capacity uplift (baseline + two tranches for Q1/Q2)
- Preserve current SLAs but add an EU-based data residency commitment

Attached is a draft private-offer summary and a proposed tranche schedule. Can you confirm the preferred invoicing cadence (monthly vs quarterly) and whether Polaris needs PO-level acceptance or an e-sign flow?

Proposed next steps:
1) We send a consolidated private offer and SOW (internal review)
2) Polaris review + redline by next Tue (2028-08-29)
3) Final DocuSign and billing setup week of Sep 4

I'll loop in Marissa (billing lead) and Laura (marketplace ops) for the logistics.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Private_Offer_Polaris_2028_08_24.pdf (pdf)]

From: sarah.jenkins@polarisanalytics.com
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@polarisanalytics.com, alan.white@polarisanalytics.com
Date: 2028-08-25T14:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Polaris Analytics renewal: aligning terms + staged capacity uplift

Thanks Markus — quick clarifying Qs before we review the doc: 
1) For the harmonized term, do you require migration of existing AWS private-offer commitments into a single account/PO?
2) Can we cap the Q2 tranche increase to 30% instead of the 50% you proposed?
3) Need confirmation on EU data residency language — is that a contractual SLA addition or an operational note?

Also, procurement prefers consolidated PO acceptance (we don't do DocuSign for marketplace private offers). We'll need a PO-ready invoice and a concise acceptance checklist for our legal and tax teams.

—Sarah
Sarah Jenkins
Sr. Procurement Manager, Polaris Analytics
[Request: sample PO template and invoice example]

From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: sarah.jenkins@polarisanalytics.com, procurement@polarisanalytics.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-26T08:27:00Z
Subject: Re: Polaris Analytics renewal: aligning terms + staged capacity uplift

Sarah — thanks, quick answers inline: 
1) Migration: yes — we can roll AWS + Azure commitments into a single consolidated PO on Polaris's master account. We'll annotate legacy usage/credit carryover in the offer.
2) Tranche cap: we can change Q2 uplift to 30%. Marked in the attached SOW.
3) EU residency: we'll add a contractual addendum (section 7.2) that commits to EU-region hosting and audit logs; SLA penalty language remains standard but operational routing will be prioritized to eu-central-1 / west-europe where available.

I've attached an updated SOW and a PO-ready invoice template for your procurement team. If procurement needs consolidated PO acceptance only, we can skip DocuSign and route a PO-level invoice to billing@redwood.ai — Marissa, can you confirm invoice format + billing contact?

Attachments: Polaris_SOW_v2.pdf, Invoice_Template_Polaris.xlsx

Best,
Markus
[Inline: On Tue, Aug 25, 2028 at 14:03, sarah.jenkins@polarisanalytics.com wrote:]
> Thanks Markus — quick clarifying Qs before we review the doc: 
> 1) For the harmonized term, do you require migration of existing AWS private-offer commitments into a single account/PO?
> ...

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai, sarah.jenkins@polarisanalytics.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-27T11:09:00Z
Subject: Re: Polaris Analytics renewal: aligning terms + staged capacity uplift

Markus / Sarah — quick billing note:
- We can issue a consolidated PO invoice with quarterly invoicing (preferred by Polaris) and split the first two tranches as 40% / 30% / 30% across the first three quarters if that helps cashflow.
- For EU VAT handling, procurement should include their VAT ID on the PO. We'll route the invoice to finance-eu@redwood.ai for processing.

Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Invoice_Template_Polaris.xlsx]

From: alan.white@polarisanalytics.com
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai, sarah.jenkins@polarisanalytics.com
Cc: procurement@polarisanalytics.com
Date: 2028-08-29T09:33:00Z
Subject: Re: Polaris Analytics renewal: aligning terms + staged capacity uplift

Markus / team — attached is Polaris's legal redline of the private offer and a short list of exceptions: 
- Request: SLA window for EU incidents to be reduced from 4 hours to 2 hours for P1 incidents impacting EU production
- Request: Add specific encryption-at-rest verbiage and KMS key residency notes

We prefer consolidated PO acceptance; procurement will share the PO by Sep 8 provided the legal exceptions are addressed.

[Attachment: Polaris_Redline_Private_Offer_2028_08_29.docx (docx)]
Regards,
Alan White
Legal Counsel, Polaris Analytics

From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: alan.white@polarisanalytics.com, sarah.jenkins@polarisanalytics.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-30T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Polaris Analytics renewal: aligning terms + staged capacity uplift

Alan / Sarah — appreciate the redline and clear asks. Quick summary of what we can commit to and the immediate next steps: 
- SLA: Can commit to 2-hour P1 response for EU-hosted incidents as an amendment to the private offer (we'll draft an SLA addendum).
- KMS: We'll include a KMS residency clause and allow Polaris to bring-your-own-key (BYOK) for EU keys where supported by the cloud provider.
- Tranche schedule: updated to 40% / 30% / 30% across first three quarters; Q2 cap at 30% (as agreed).

Next steps:
1) Redwood will produce a final private-offer PDF (attached) incorporating the SLA addendum and KMS language.
2) Polaris procurement to issue consolidated PO to billing@redwood.ai by 2028-09-08.
3) Kickoff onboarding call scheduled for 2028-09-11 at 15:00 CEST — calendar invite forthcoming.

Attaching: Redwood_Private_Offer_Polaris_2028_08_30.pdf, Polaris_SOW_v2.pdf
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-2028-0921
DocuSign (optional): https://www.docusign.com/link/to/packet/abc123

Thanks everyone — I will follow up once billing confirms the PO template and Marissa will confirm invoice routing.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachments: Redwood_Private_Offer_Polaris_2028_08_30.pdf, Polaris_SOW_v2.pdf]
